purpose: single source of truth for training, offline evaluation, inference and packaging

required_fields.code_hash: sha256 of the training/feature/inference source used
feature_order: ordered list of feature column names
required_fields.feature_order_hash: sha256 of the ordered feature list
required_fields.legal_input_contract: three tables, lookback<=120, daily Barra universe
required_fields.family: lgbm | catboost | tabm | resmlp | tcn | ridge
required_fields.inner_protocol: inner fit / validation split with label_end boundary
required_fields.outer_protocol: outer refit rule; must re-initialise model, optimiser and RNG
required_fields.train_threads: int (LightGBM is not bit-identical across thread counts)
required_fields.fusion_graph_id: must match the frozen graph definition
required_fields.package_hash: sha256 of the released zip (filled at packaging time)

hard_rules: number of declared seeds must equal the number of atom weight files
duplicate atom hashes are rejected (they cannot stand in for different seeds)
fusion must follow the frozen graph: atom rank -> seed mean -> weighted sum -> final rank
no member may be silently dropped or zero-filled at inference time

frozen_fusion_graph.rank_operator: r_t(x)=(average_rank(x)-(n_t+1)/2)/n_t inside the day's legal pool
frozen_fusion_graph.step2: same recipe seeds: q_g = mean_seed r_t(s_g,seed) (no extra family rank)
frozen_fusion_graph.step3: u = sum_g w_g q_g, w_g>=0, sum w_g = 1

atom_manifest.scope: one recipe x one seed x one training cutoff x one weight file

ensemble_manifest.scope: expert list x seed list x frozen fusion graph
hard_fail_if: family weights negative or not summing to 1
feature order hash mismatch vs feature list
extra family-level rank found in the shipped scorer

package_hash_location: release manifest OUTSIDE the zip; never written back into the zip's own internal manifest (that would be a self-referential hash)
enforcement: these are machine assertions in the packing/acceptance code from V1 on; the schema text itself is not the enforcement
